businessName.title: Business name to search
businessName.description: A single business/company name (or fragment) to search for in Ghana's ORC registry.

businessNames.title: Business names to search
businessNames.description: Multiple business/company names (or fragments) to search for in one run.

searchType.title: Search type
searchType.description: How each query is matched against registered business names. "Contains" is broadest but can return very large result sets for common words (e.g. "GHANA" contains-matches tens of thousands of names).

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Caps how many matching business names are pushed to the dataset per query. The registry has no server-side result limit, so a broad query can match tens of thousands of names -- this truncates the OUTPUT only (the full response is still downloaded and parsed either way). _totalAvailable on each record shows how many actually matched.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many queries to run in parallel. Kept low by default -- this is a small, early-stage (v0.0.1) government web app, not a high-capacity API.
